items.summary: Former CIA counterintelligence analyst Peter Mattis tells Bloomberg This Weekend how China’s Ministry of State Security can use business and personal relationships to gather intelligence and potentially influence decision-making in strategically important industries. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Mattis explains why technology executives can become valuable targets even without access to classified information and how AI is expanding the capabilities of Chinese intelligence operations. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Review: Fed’s Collins Says ‘Steady, Gradual’ Rate Hikes Appropriate
items.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston President Susan Collins said a gradual path for interest-rate hikes will be appropriate to lower inflation, as the labor market gains solid footing without adding to price pressures.

items.title: Review: The Stadium Bidding War Shaking Up the Midwest
items.summary: The Chicago Bears are weighing three possible homes for a new stadium: downtown Chicago, suburban Arlington Heights and Hammond, Indiana. The competition has turned into a high-stakes economic development battle involving billions of dollars in potential investment, tax incentives and public financing. Supporters say a new stadium could generate jobs, development and tax revenue, but former Indiana Governor Mitch Daniels warns that emotion can push politicians into deals that leave taxpayers paying the bill long after the ribbon cutting. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Review: How the University of North Carolina Tried to Avoid Trump’s Wrath
items.summary: The University of North Carolina’s chancellor tried to protect the school from the Trump administration. Work on cancer, suicide, AIDS and coronaviruses was hit anyway.

items.title: Review: This tiny gamepad with dual analog thumbsticks pushes the limits of portable controllers
items.summary: As much as I appreciate the ingenious design of the Nintendo Switch's Joy-Con, my family and I can't stand using them as standalone gamepads. So when we travel with the Switch 2, we always bring at least one full-size gamepad, plus a couple of 8BitDo's Zero 2 controllers for games that don't use analog thumbsticks.

items.title: Review: Alaska voters aren't ditching ranked choice voting, top-four primaries
items.summary: This is the second time Alaskans voted down an effort to repeal the state's unique election system, which voters first approved in 2020. A repeal effort in 2024 also failed narrowly.

items.title: Review: What’s Behind the Trump-Huang Relationship?
items.summary: President Trump’s show of support for Jensen Huang as he was under fire was a remarkable moment in a relationship that barely existed two years ago. Our White House correspondent Maggie Haberman explains how Mr. Trump came to see Mr. Huang as a modern-day Henry Ford.

items.title: Review: Goldman Sachs Sees 19% Return on Asia ex-Japan Stocks in 2027
items.summary: Goldman Sachs expects earnings growth to drive a 19% return for the MSCI Asia ex-Japan Index in dollar terms next year, even as it warned that uncertainty over artificial intelligence could fuel volatility.
